config.name: g1_wbc_envelope
config.notes: Gates pre-registered before the full run. Pitch 0.6 rad exceeds the waist range (+-0.52) and is recorded as a rejection. Torque ratio = |commanded motor torque| / actuatorfrcrange of the MJCF (the sim motors are not force-limited, so a ratio above 1 is a torque the real joint could not deliver). rpy error is the torso in the gravity-aligned heading frame (yaw-only pelvis); the waist-chain (upstream FK) value is also stored. Arms-forward pose: both shoulder pitch -1.4 rad, rest 0.
